name: Honeydew Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Honeydew is a sativa strain with a flavor profile that is true to its name. Its complex terpene profile offers notes of delicious, sweet melon and fruity berry. Its aroma is like a wooden bowl of freshly cut melon, berries and fruits with a touch of hazy earthiness. Honeydew keeps you motivated, making it an ideal strain for an afternoon adventure or creative escapes, and you'll experience happy, creative, euphoric, relaxing and uplifting effects.
